name: Enkai Rooms
description: Enkai Rooms is a block theme for a restaurant that keeps three private rooms for company dinners, family celebrations and wedding parties, on the harbour at 14 Harbour Steps, Calder. The home page opens on a diagonal seam between two low-key photographs under a hanging paper tag, then moves through a wide room photograph, four abutting photo tiles, a dark ledger of the rooms, per-head price rows, a parallax band and one repeated way to ask about a date. Warm black and pale grey with russet and gold accents; Cormorant Garamond for headings, Source Sans 3 for reading. Sample content in English, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, French and German. Works without WooCommerce. WCAG AA colours; scroll effects respect reduced motion.
